english: No candidate has a structured disclosure timestamp on every research session, with observation_date strictly before D and the clock strictly before 09:15 Asia/Shanghai on D. Financing covers the 3659 sessions in the provider table, and its lineage statuses are PROVIDER_HISTORY_NOT_PIT 3659 and PROVIDER_HISTORY_REACQUIRED_NOT_PIT 3659. The exchange capture covers 34 sessions, PIT_certified values are False 68, capture-clock fields are first_captured_at_utc 64, source_run_started_at_utc 4, and those clocks run from 2026-10-21T03:55:49Z to 2026-10-26T08:48:48.991185+00:00; 0 of those capture times fall before the next pre-open, and a capture time would not count as disclosure anyway. Turnover is historical_publication_times_certified=False, constituents independently verified=False, and both the native-rate request and a float-A repair still say 最新. Market-breadth filename search found no files. Index amount and the 000300/000852 controls are OFFICIAL_HISTORY_NOT_PIT; the 000985 receipt clock is 2026-10-30T08:04:37.740882+00:00 to 2026-10-30T08:04:39.744425+00:00. Amount and style were already compared and are not re-run: 5_TOP price 23.6%/44.7% versus amount+style 18.3%/39.5%; 5_BOTTOM price 33.9%/51.3% versus amount+style 31.1%/48.7%; 9_TOP price 15.2%/38.9% versus amount+style 20.5%/50.0%; 9_BOTTOM price 15.7%/42.1% versus amount+style 17.3%/47.4%. The displayed baseline stayed on the price group. Official peg and consNumber are unused raw fields on that same receipt. The next step is to collect certified per-session disclosure timestamps for the Shanghai and Shenzhen financing balances. That collection is not done here. No family was fit. formal_signal_allowed stays false. This is not PIT, not a blind test, and not a signal. P1 remains BLOCKED_NO_CONCENTRATION. P1b remains GO_PRE_PIVOT_COORDINATE. P1c remains BLOCKED_NO_WINDOW_PEAK. P1d remains GO_NEW_FACTORS.
